_readme: Photo albums for /gallery. Hand-edited. `frames` are [prefix, from, to] number ranges in the photo library (pik = TOUR folder, abz = WILDLIFE PHOTOS folder); `include` adds exact stems; `exclude` drops stems; `guests: true` marks albums of guest (not staff) trips. `npm run albums` picks the best frame from each run of near-duplicates and writes data/album-photos.json plus the encoded sizes in public/images/gallery/. Set `"hidden": true` on an album to leave it off the site entirely (its photos are then not encoded into the build).
